description: This file defines the PlayerActivity class, which is a UI component in an Android app responsible for playing video workouts using ExoPlayer. It manages media playback, overlays with workout info, and keeps UI updates synchronized with playback.

classes.name: PlayerActivity
classes.description: An activity class that manages video playback of workout videos and displays overlay information such as title, elapsed time, and calories.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and retrieves workout data from intent extras.

methods.name: initPlayer
methods.description: Sets up the ExoPlayer instance, prepares media, and starts playback.

methods.name: updateOverlay
methods.description: Updates the overlay views to show current playback position and estimated calories.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the player when activity starts.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the periodic UI updates when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the UI updates when activity pauses.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Releases media resources and stops UI updates when activity stops.
